title: 'Nozzlegate' erupts as Prusa CORE One 3D printer kits arrive with soft steel nozzles — Bondtech admits machining flaws with no quick fix (Updated)
summary: Bondtech, the inventor of the INDX toolchanger system used to create the highly anticipated Prusa CORE One+ INDX , admitted to a significant mistake. As an olive branch, Prusa Research INDX conversion kits will included extra hardware free of charge.
